acceptanceCriteria: A1: governance_integrity_gate_test.sh passes when executed with release-tag GITHUB_* environment variables, proving fixture cases explicitly control their event context.
A2: the regression test proves the same fixture report and exit status under ordinary and release-tag environments, while real release-tag fixtures retain strict tag validation.
A3: release source_quality gates pass locally and in GitHub Actions without changing immutable v0.2.26 or using source/workspace fallback.
A4: the Work Item records verification evidence and a visible human Outcome; no unrelated Agent/MCP/global configuration is modified.
goal: 根治发布治理回归测试受 GitHub release 环境变量污染而产生本地/CI 分歧的问题。
intent: 让 governance_integrity_gate_test.sh 在任何 CI 事件上下文中都显式设置每个 fixture 的事件环境，避免 awaiting-merge-close 等非 tag fixture 被误判为真实 release tag，同时保留真实 release-tag fixture 的严格验证。
outOfScope: or reusing the immutable v0.2.26 tag
Changing Runtime governance semantics unrelated to fixture event isolation

scenarioCoverage.expected: Fixture event context is explicit and the regression passes under release-tag environment variables.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run governance_integrity_gate_test.sh with GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push and GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v0.2.26.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The same fixture cases produce the same findings and exit status without release environment variables.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run governance_integrity_gate_test.sh in a clean non-release environment and compare the deterministic report.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The failed v0.2.26 publication remains immutable and is not rewritten by this fix.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Verify tag object and release history remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.reason: This successor fixes the test harness on origin/main and cannot mutate an already-created release tag.
